question: Who among the following nominates one-sixth members to the state legislative council of a state in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Governor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Governor** is the constitutional head of a state in India and acts on the advice of the **Council of Ministers**.
 
• Under **Article 171** of the Indian Constitution, the State Legislative Council consists of members who are elected and nominated.
 
• The Governor has the power to **nominate one-sixth of the members** of the State Legislative Council.
 
• The nominated members are chosen from fields like **literature, science, art, cooperative movement, and social service.**
 
• This provision ensures representation of **eminent personalities** who might not be elected through regular electoral procedures.
 
• The nomination process helps in maintaining a balance between **technical expertise** and **political representation** within the legislative council.
 
• The Governor's role in this context emphasizes the importance of a **non-partisan and inclusive approach** to governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** State Election Commissioner**__

 __
 
• The **State Election Commissioner** is responsible for conducting elections for local bodies such as **panchayats** and **municipalities** within the state.
 
• This position is independent of the legislative council nomination process.
 
• The State Election Commissioner operates under the **supervision of the Election Commission of India** and is governed by provisions of the **73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments**.
 
 
 
• ** President**__
 __
 
• The **President** of India is the constitutional head of the union government and has powers related to the **Parliament**, not the State Legislative Council.
 
• While the President nominates members to the **Rajya Sabha**, they do not have a role in nominating members to a state’s legislative council.
 
 
 
• ** Chief Minister**__
 
 
• The **Chief Minister** is the head of the government in a state and leads the **executive branch**.
 
• Although the Chief Minister advises the Governor, they do not have the power to nominate members to the State Legislative Council directly.
 
• The Chief Minister’s role is primarily focused on **administrative and policy-making decisions** within the state.
